config._note: goals-okr (2026-07-15): the measurable, cross-review sibling of PerformanceReviewDetail (ADR-001 Rule 6 — the primary surface is the EmployeeDetail emp-objectives row / ReviewCycleDetail rc-objectives row; this page is a routed detail, reached from those rows or the deepLink, and is deliberately NOT a menu child, the PerformanceReviewDetail/TimesheetDetail convention). The 'Objective' data widget carries title/ownerType/period/status/uitkomst/progress, excluding employeeId/orgUnitId/cycleId (Related resolves and links all three by name) and userId (the internal @me self-service field, not a display fact). The 'Key results' object-list (KeyResult.objectiveId = @objectId) lists this objective's measurable children, rowRoute to KeyResultDetail. lifecycleActions expose exactly activeren/afsluiten (concept->actief->afgesloten, hr-okr.json) -- no guard, no re-open edge, a closed objective is history (the ReviewCycle no-resurrection precedent). Audit history is a sidebar tab.

params.title: Key Result
params.note: goals-okr (2026-07-15): a leaf under ObjectiveDetail's 'Key results' list (routed detail, reached from that row or the deepLink, deliberately NOT a menu child). The 'Key result' data widget carries title/unit/startValue/targetValue/currentValue/progress/status, excluding objectiveId and userId (Related resolves and links the parent Objective by name; userId is the internal @me-adjacent denorm field, not a display fact). No lifecycleActions -- KeyResult carries only a plain status enum, no x-openregister-lifecycle. Audit history is a sidebar tab.
